# A prerequisites page that matches what CI tests

- **Source:** The v0.1 public preview bar (docs/release/v0.1-bar.md) and Decider D121 (2026-10-29).

- **Story:** As Dana, I want the supported .NET SDK version, operating systems and architecture stated in one place, so that I know before installing whether it will work for me.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the repository, When the prerequisites page is read, Then it states the .NET SDK version, the Windows and Linux versions or distributions and the architecture that CI actually uses, and what to do on others
  2. Given a test, When it runs, Then it checks that the SDK version and operating systems on the page match the CI workflow matrix, so the page cannot drift
  3. Given the page, When Dana is on Windows without bash, Then a PowerShell equivalent is given for each command the guide uses

## Context

- One concern per document: prerequisites only; the guide links to it. Follow docs/CODING_GUIDELINES.md; keep the change small enough to revert alone.
